trap.label: promessas (collocations)
trap.wrong: She did her promise. He broke the promise. I did a promise to my mother.
trap.right: She kept her promise. He broke his promise. I made a promise to my mother.
trap.why: Em português “fazer uma promessa” e “cumprir” se resolvem com fazer/cumprir. O brasileiro usa do. Em inglês, make a promise, keep a promise, break a promise.

mcq.q: I ___ a promise to my mother.

fix.wrong: He broke the promise to she.
fix.right: He broke his promise to her.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com make: “She promised to help.”
rewrite.answer: She made a promise to help.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva no passado: “He breaks his promise.”
Reescreva com keep: “I fulfill my word.” (promise)
